subject: The business domain of authoring and compiling governed models, not the commerce domain of an example

nodes.label: Authored domain model
nodes.meaning: Contains declarations for one explicit domain and owner.

nodes.label: Domain declaration
nodes.meaning: Binds a construct contract to concrete domain meaning.

nodes.label: Language construct contract
nodes.meaning: Defines required information, semantics, validation and limits.

nodes.label: Concrete Mapping declaration
nodes.meaning: Binds source/target shapes and field clauses.

nodes.label: Concrete Policy declaration
nodes.meaning: Binds ordered cases and an explicit default.

nodes.label: Compiler capability description
nodes.meaning: Describes which construct contracts the compiler promises to support.

nodes.label: Unresolved meaning or unsupported construct
nodes.meaning: Prevents a successful complete lowering claim; retains owner and reason.

nodes.label: Selected compiler binding
nodes.meaning: Names the external compiler and compatible input/profile without claiming a completed lowering.

nodes.label: Compilation evidence
nodes.meaning: Reports success, rejection or incompatibility with bounded provenance.

relations.meaning: The domain owner supplies or reviews the authored model.
A model contains its domain declarations.
A declaration must satisfy its selected construct contract.
The language owner controls the meaning of each construct contract.
A concrete Mapping is one kind of domain declaration.
A concrete Policy is another kind of domain declaration.
The compiler description promises support for bounded construct contracts.
A declaration may expose missing or unsupported meaning.
Unresolved required meaning blocks successful complete lowering of that model.
A compiler capability may have a selected compiler realization candidate.
The selected compiler produces evidence only for inputs it actually accepts.

cross_view_links.meaning: This description documents the existing product compiler capability; it is not a new product capability.

boundary: All roles and edges here are business/proposal roles, not DomainSpec executable meta-types. Mapping and Policy are declarations; input values, evaluation and runtime invocations remain distinct.
